strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Enemy enters Castle Uroporos 3. Gran Garan destroyed
Dammit, it's down to just us...!
Nie... What do we do!?
Nothing to do but fight! How's the castle's anti-air fire?
No good. Without Aura Battlers, it's a drop in the bucket.
Lady Elle, wouldn't it be wise to withdraw for now and regroup?
No. Just a little longer, just a little more...
My, my, finished already!? Haha, what a letdown.
Jeryl. Underestimate your opponent too much and you'll get burned.
Hah! Who do you think you're talking to? Save that line for Fei.
He's at the Storm Sphere. If he screws up, I'll just laugh at him.
...But Jeryl, we could end up getting laughed at too, you know?
Don't lump me in with him. Or are you scared?
They say Byston Well's gotten awfully restless lately.
Geez... You never listen. Fine. Jeryl, do your job right, okay?
I take the castle, you sink that battleship... Got it?
I know. I'll make short work of it!
Marvel sent word that Show is back...
We hold them off somehow until then. Got it, Keen!?
We've got no choice, right?
I won't let them near the castle or the battleship!
(Lady Sheela is still missing... Morale just keeps falling.
...Show, hurry... Hurry back to us!)
Nie! Keen! Are you all right!?
Don't scare me like that! Is that you, Show? How'd you get to the castle!?
A castle always has a secret passage.
We came in by following it in reverse.
Show! The battleship's in danger too!
Show Zama, that battleship must not be destroyed. ...Please protect it.
Got it. I'll test the power of this new Aura Battler...!
...Holy Warrior... I'm counting on you.
Nie! Keen! Are you all right!?
That's...Show!
Show! You really are safe!
Sorry! I made you worry.
So let's make up for it big time!
That's right! We're going all out, so don't fall behind!
Show, that squad of Aura Battlers I've never seen,
are they your comrades from the surface!?
They're allies! I've filled them in, so work with them.
They're not Aura Battlers, though.
What's going on? Those are surface robots... mobile suits, right?
And there are some unfamiliar ones mixed in.
Tch, so others besides us got summoned here too.
Who cares what they are!
Besides, looks like Show Zama's here too,
so glory just fell right into our laps.
Show! Did you rescue Queen Sheela!?
Not yet, we couldn't pin down the Storm Sphere's location.
We came here first! We'll head there after this!
Got it! Let's clean things up here first!
Amuro! We'll guard the castle! You guard the ship, the Gran Garan!
Understood.
All right, spread out, push them back, and protect both castle and ship. Go!
Marvel! What about the Wil Wiph at Karakara!?
We drove it off for now. With these people's help, that is.
Then we can do this. We'll push them back here too!
Jeryl and Allen's squad were taking a while... So this is why!
Reinforcements!? No way!
Dammit, after we pushed them back this far...!
Stop buzzing around, you're so annoying!
Don't panic. Just think of it as more enemies from the start!
This feeling... You're here! Show Zama!
You're... Burn Bunnings!
I heard you'd gone missing, but you're alive after all!
Good... I'm the one who will defeat you!
Heh, looks like he's a celebrity with the locals.
The locals...huh.
He's raring to go. Show, what'd you do to make him hate you so much?
I don't know! He just holds a grudge on his own!
Maybe he just hasn't noticed.
Show's kinda dense, after all.
You're awfully relaxed... Show Zama! But!
This is no time to be joking around! Here they come!
Impossible!? Me!?
Can we take him down!?
Whoa, not so fast! I never forget a humiliation!
Ngh, surface dweller... I wanted to finish him here...
Why you...! Don't you underestimate me!
Jeryl Kuchibi! Your Aura Power... it's stronger than before...!
Hah! Lately I've got power to spare!
That Aura Power of yours!
Quit your yapping! Next time for sure... Remember that!
Jeryl...
Show, it's wrong... That woman's Aura Power is...
I know, Cham. Jeryl's Aura Power... it's a dangerous power.
Looks like we...managed to hold them off.
Seriously. At first I didn't know what we'd do.
Thank you, everyone.
Don't mention it. We all help each other in tough times.
Lady Sheela, I'm so glad you're safe.
I've caused you trouble as well, Lady Elle.
Trouble? Not at all...
The Kingdom of Na must finish the Gran Garan as soon as possible
and crush Drake's ambitions.
Yes, Lady Sheela.
Show Zama.
Lady Sheela... I've received the Aura Battler Billbine.
I'll use it to defeat Drake.
The battle with Drake... If we're in time, I'll join it with the Gran Garan.
I pray for your fortune in battle, Holy Warrior.
...Yes.
She's so dignified. A real queen.
...If only that princess of ours were a bit more like that.
What...do we do next, Amuro?
Anyway... it all comes down to this Drake's castle.
Though I don't know if we can really get home...
What're you talking so gutless for!?
We've got a mountain of stuff to do back on the surface.
Exactly. Let's go, Show.
Before that... we have to go to the Storm Sphere. Lady Sheela is there.
To stand against Drake, we need her power.
Right. Above all, the Gran Garan can't move without her.
The Storm Sphere? What the heck's that?
It seems to be something unique to this world, at least.
I'll explain later. Right now we need to move, and fast.
Let's go. Something's wrong with Byston Well right now.
If it's connected to the surface world...
then as someone from the surface, I can't just leave it be.
Yeah. Like me and Todd, suddenly thrown out onto the surface,
or getting pulled in, like this time... Something's going on...
We have to figure out what.
All riiight! Let's gooo!
Easy, Cham. What about you guys, Nie?
Keen and I will stay to defend this castle.
We've beaten their main force, and the Gran Garan's almost finished.
We can handle it on our own.
...Got it. I'm counting on you, Nie.
You're the one who needs to...do your best, Show.
